description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application. It provides system endpoints such as root greeting, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing system-related endpoints such as welcome, docs, health, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at root ('/') and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, constructing URL based on request headers.

methods.name: headerOrDefault
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve a header value or return a default if header is missing or blank.

methods.name: parsePort
methods.description: Parses a port number from string, returns default on failure.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health' and returns application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/api/info' and returns application information.
